summary: Backend: 30 pytest cases (28 pass) plus extra checks (public URL analyze, hex-IP SSRF, >10k text, non-JSON body, all OK). Health/ready/sources, 401 gating on every private route, analyze (ML track + Groq explanation + evidence summary, persisted), SSRF blocks (169.254.169.254, localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1], 0x7f000001 all 422), history CRUD, RLS isolation between tester1 and tester2, discover and 400 validation all work. Two CORS issues: (1) the backend allow-list matches regexes by prefix only, so https://x.preview.emergentagent.com.evil.example.com gets reflected in ACAO (app bug); (2) https://evil.example.com gets no ACAO from Flask, but the public ingress adds 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' (platform layer, not app). Frontend (375x667): every requested flow passes: sign-in (empty and wrong-password errors), sign-up validation (mismatch, short password), Analyze with separate ML and evidence cards and the separation note with no combined verdict, URL mode errors, History list/detail/delete confirm/Clear all, Discover search and chips, Sources, Alerts empty state, Settings status/providers, Terms/Privacy, Sign out and auth guard. Main visible bug: Google News evidence snippets show raw HTML ('<a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/...'). No deprecated Expo packages found.

critical.issue: flask-cors matches regex origins with re.match (prefix only). Origin 'https://x.preview.emergentagent.com.evil.example.com' is allowed and reflected in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, both locally and via the public URL. The patterns are also broad enough to allow ANY *.preview.emergentagent.com / *.emergent.host app. Fix: anchor the patterns, e.g. r'^https://[a-z0-9-]+\.preview\.emergentagent\.com$', or better, allow only the exact EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL origin plus APP_ORIGINS.

minor.issue: Flask-CORS logs 'Unknown option passed to Flask-CORS: allow_methods'. The kwarg should be 'methods', so the method restriction is silently ignored.

The snippet is only html.unescape'd, never stripped of tags. Google News RSS summaries come through as raw '...' HTML and appear verbatim in the Analyze evidence card, the detail screen and Discover results. Strip tags (e.g. BeautifulSoup(snippet,'html.parser').get_text(' ', strip=True)) before storing.

The platform ingress adds 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' on GET /api/* for an origin Flask rejects (https://evil.example.com). This is outside app code. The impact is limited because auth is a Bearer header, not cookies. Mention it in docs.
Through the public URL, /health (no /api prefix) is routed to the Expo frontend and returns HTML. The backend route only works internally. Use /api/health for external probes.

At 18:46:57 the backend log showed 'evidence_pool lookup/insert failed: Database request failed (404)'. The table now exists and a manual ingest_job() run succeeded (30 records). Probably the schema was applied after startup, so this looks transient. Consider retrying or logging the response body.
DNS is resolved in _assert_safe and then again by requests (TOCTOU / DNS-rebinding window). Low risk; pin the resolved IP if you want to harden it.

ui_bugs.issue: Raw HTML anchor markup is shown as snippet text for Google News items (backend root cause above).
The /analysis/[id] header says 'Analyze' (t('analyze.title')) instead of an analysis-detail title. Reference: app/analysis/[id].tsx:45

Link href='/sign-in' pushes a second sign-in screen onto the stack, leaving duplicate hidden sign-in inputs in the DOM (also back-stack growth). Use router.replace or router.back. Reference: app/sign-up.tsx:68,111; app/sign-in.tsx:80

issues: When there is no back button, the header title is still indented by an empty icon slot of about 40px, so 'Analyze'/'History'/'Settings'/'NewsSearch' do not line up with the 16px content gutter. Reference: src/components/Screen.tsx:84-91

SectionHeader repeats the same text as eyebrow and title ('SYSTEM STATUS' / 'System status', 'DISCOVERY PROVIDERS' / 'Discovery providers', 'DATA AND RETENTION' / 'Data and retention', 'LEGAL' / 'Legal'). Reference: app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:74,105,120
Account email appears twice (section title and the 'Signed in as' card).
The primary Search/Analyze button sits flush against the input above it with no vertical gap (needs about 8-16px).
Discover shows a 'Discover' field label right under the 'Discover' header (redundant).
The 'History cleared.' toast covers the header title at the top. Acceptable, but consider placing it below the header.

action_items: HIGH: Anchor the CORS origin regexes (or use exact origins) in server.py _cors_origins, so suffix-appended attacker domains and other apps on the preview domain are rejected.
HIGH: Strip HTML tags from provider snippets in providers.py _make_item (Google News RSS summary contains <a>/<font> markup) before persisting and returning.
Rename the Flask-CORS kwarg allow_methods -> methods in server.py.
Use a detail-specific header title on /analysis/[id].
Use router.replace/back for the sign-up <-> sign-in links to avoid stacking duplicate auth screens.
AppHeader: don't reserve the back-icon slot when there is no back button. Settings: remove the duplicated eyebrow/title text. Add a gap between inputs and primary buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS regex origins are prefix-matched by flask-cors (re.match), so they are bypassable.
server.py rate limiting is in-memory per process; with multiple Gunicorn workers the effective limit is multiplied and resets on restart.
supa.py raises 502 'database_request_failed' for any PostgREST 4xx/5xx and drops the response body. Log the body so schema/RLS errors are diagnosable.
providers.py snippets are not HTML-sanitized (see above).

success_rate.backend: 93% (28/30; 1 real app CORS bug, 1 ingress-level ACAO '*')
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; 1 high-visibility content bug (raw HTML snippets)

seed_data_creation: No new users. Analyses created by tests were deleted (both testers' histories cleared). One manual ingestion.ingest_job() run inserted 30 evidence_pool rows (normal app behavior).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Get tokens via Supabase password grant (the test file reads keys from backend/.env). Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_newssearch_api.py (pytest.ini enables xdist; add -p no:xdist -o addopts='' -s to see prints). Each run makes about 1-3 analyze calls per xdist worker (rate limit 30/h/user). The web stack keeps hidden screens in the DOM: use ':visible' or specific testIDs (settings-terms-link, settings-privacy-link) rather than text selectors. Tabs have no testIDs; click by tab label text with .last.
rca_of_issue: CORS bypass: flask_cors.core.try_match uses re.match(pattern, origin), and the pattern r'https://.*\.preview\.emergentagent\.com' has no '$', so any origin starting with a preview subdomain matches. Raw HTML snippet: Google News RSS <description> is HTML; providers._make_item only unescapes entities.
